tldr: > 部分內容為近期（非當日）可確認之要聞。/ Some items reflect recent (not same-day) confirmed news.
台積電2026年第三季營收9,899億元創單季新高、季增6%且優於財測，法說會前股價早盤觸及2,580元歷史天價。
元大投顧重申台積電未來2至3年先進製程與封裝均無具威脅競爭者，目標價上修至3,500元。
金管會核准法巴銀行、彰化銀行進駐高雄亞資專區，進駐銀行增至20家，高資產受託規模突破2.66兆元。

items.title_zh: 台積電第三季營收9,899億元創單季新高、季增6%
items.title_en: TSMC posts record Q3 revenue of NT$989.9bn, up 6% QoQ
items.summary_zh: 台積電公布2026年第三季合併營收9,899億元，季增6%且超越自身財測上緣，改寫單季歷史新高。數據在10月15日法說會前公布，印證AI需求續強，使台積電續為加權指數主要風向。
items.summary_en: TSMC reported third-quarter 2026 consolidated revenue of NT$989.9 billion, a 6% sequential gain that beat its own guidance and set an all-time quarterly high. The print, released ahead of the Oct 15 earnings call, reinforces AI-driven demand strength and keeps the stock central to the index's direction.

items.title_zh: 台積電法說會前股價觸及2,580元歷史天價
items.title_en: TSMC shares touch record high near NT$2,580 before earnings call
items.summary_zh: 台積電10月15日法說會登場前，股價早盤攻抵約2,580元歷史新高，法人提前卡位看好單季表現。權值王走高帶動加權指數，顯示法說行情主導近期台股情緒。
items.summary_en: Ahead of TSMC's Oct 15 results, the stock rallied to an all-time intraday high around NT$2,580 as institutions positioned for a strong quarter. The move lifted the weighted index's heavyweight component and underscored how earnings-call expectations are driving near-term equity sentiment.

items.title_zh: 元大投顧：台積電無具威脅對手，目標價上修至3,500元
items.title_en: Yuanta: TSMC has no credible rival, target raised to NT$3,500
items.summary_zh: 元大投顧表示，台積電未來2至3年於先進製程與先進封裝均無具威脅性的競爭者，維持「買進」並將目標價由3,300元上修至3,500元，並預期第三季營運優於財測上緣，凸顯晶圓代工龍頭地位穩固。
items.summary_en: Yuanta Securities said TSMC will face no threatening competitor in advanced process and advanced packaging over the next two to three years, maintaining a Buy and lifting its target price to NT$3,500 from NT$3,300. It expects Q3 operations to exceed the upper end of guidance, signalling sustained foundry leadership.

items.title_zh: AI帶動出口動能，9月料再刷新高
items.title_en: Taiwan's AI-led export momentum points to record September
items.summary_zh: 財政部預估9月出口約770億至803億美元、年增42%至48%，可望寫下連35紅的史上最長紀錄。AI、高效能運算與雲端需求仍為主力，使科技供應鏈持續扮演台灣貿易引擎。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance projected September exports of US$77-80.3 billion, a 42-48% YoY jump that would extend the longest-ever winning streak to 35 straight months. AI, high-performance computing and cloud demand remain the main drivers, keeping the tech supply chain the engine of Taiwan's trade.

items.title_zh: 金管會四年金融資安韌性藍圖，2026訂安全基準
items.title_en: FSC's four-year cyber-resilience roadmap sets 2026 security baselines
items.summary_zh: 金管會發布「金融資安韌性發展藍圖」，涵蓋四大主軸、29項措施，其中API安全基準與AI系統安全防護指引預定2026年底前完成。隨數位金融與AI應用加速，全體銀行與保險業的法遵要求同步提高。
items.summary_en: The FSC published a financial cyber-resilience blueprint spanning four pillars and 29 measures, with API security baselines and AI-system protection guidelines due by end-2026. The plan raises compliance demands on banks and insurers as digital finance and AI adoption accelerate across the sector.

items.title_zh: 國銀放款續增，個人放款成主力
items.title_en: Domestic bank lending extends growth, led by personal loans
items.summary_zh: 國銀放款單月再增1,341億元，個人放款為主要動能，房貸與消費性信用維持穩健。放款穩步擴張顯示在總體審慎監理趨嚴下，家庭端資金需求仍具韌性。
items.summary_en: Domestic banks' outstanding loans rose a further NT$134.1 billion month-on-month, with personal lending the main contributor as mortgage and consumer credit stayed firm. The steady credit expansion signals resilient household demand even amid tighter macro-prudential scrutiny.

items.title_zh: 金管會核准法巴、彰銀進駐高雄亞資專區
items.title_en: FSC admits BNP Paribas and Chang Hwa to Kaohsiung asset-management zone
items.summary_zh: 金管會核准法國巴黎銀行與彰化銀行進駐高雄亞洲資產管理中心專區，進駐銀行增至20家。試辦涵蓋授信（Lombard借貸、保險融資）、家族辦公室與跨境金融，深化留住高資產資金在台布局。
items.summary_en: The FSC approved BNP Paribas and Chang Hwa Bank into the Kaohsiung asset-management pilot zone, lifting participating banks to 20. Pilot services cover lending (Lombard lending, insurance financing), family offices and cross-border finance, deepening Taiwan's push to retain high-net-worth capital onshore.

items.title_zh: 玉山×KPMG報告：高資產客戶估增至12.4萬人、掌46.1兆元
items.title_en: E.Sun-KPMG study: high-net-worth clients to reach 124,000 holding NT$46.1tn
items.summary_zh: 玉山銀行與KPMG報告估計，2026年資產逾1億元的高資產客戶將增至12.4萬人，合計掌握46.1兆元財富。此預估凸顯私人銀行與財富傳承市場快速成長，各銀行競相搶進。
items.summary_en: A joint E.Sun Bank and KPMG report estimated Taiwan's high-asset clients (over NT$100 million) will rise to 124,000 in 2026, collectively commanding NT$46.1 trillion in wealth. The projection highlights a fast-growing private-banking and succession-planning market that banks are racing to capture.
